name: Unlock All
description: Unlocks every icon, color and main level.

unlock-icons.name: Unlock Icons
unlock-icons.description: Unlocks every icon in the icon kit (cubes, ships, balls, UFOs, waves, robots, spiders, swings, jetpacks, death effects, trails and ship fire).

unlock-colors.name: Unlock Colors
unlock-colors.description: Unlocks every primary, secondary and glow color.

unlock-levels.name: Unlock Main Levels
unlock-levels.description: Removes the secret coin requirement from locked main levels (Clubstep, Theory of Everything 2, Deadlocked, ...).
